summary: Qwen camp is sitting on a fat 115k pile like they actually know what they're doing with SOL, even if their so-called best line about notable growth was basically copy-pasted from their worst line about significant momentum. Claude camp is the undisputed bottom feeder at just over 101k, looking like they got their trading strategy from a fortune cookie and then immediately lost the slip. Llama at least had the decency to step over gemini and claude, while deepseek briefly bullied llama out of the way, but it's all just sad little side quests while qwen laps the entire field.
